items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: He's like Mr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde. He gets drunk and that's -- his big problem is his drinking. But he's a great guy.

ctx.x: Offer him a drink. He doesn't know how to say no. But he's a nice guy. He's like Mr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde. He gets drunk and that's -- his big problem is his drinking. But he's a great guy.
Oh, I'm so glad to hear you say that.
